raidSayLines.line: A woman, maybe 50s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Something pads into the clearing — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline. It's here.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
🩸 The dog-shaped silence at the treeline mauled Jayden (-54 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
⚔️ Cameron stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 2 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, two knobs on glass-still water, watching, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, two knobs on glass-still water, watching, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build

📓 Journal: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, two knobs on glass-still water, watching, stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still at the door, day 7.
One of them is coming for YOU — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔️ Dwayne stared down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
